comments_sample.text: I love the 'Popular Monster & Beyond' era of Falling in Reverse musically, but this album had something quite special emotionally that still hits hard today. I hope eventually we get another album like this in the future, this was a phenomenal release!

comments_sample.author: @frankcantatore4218
comments_sample.text:
My interpretation of the lyrics.

Hey girl I'm in love with you, but it feel like the world is always making the timing of our love never work out.

I'm love sick. Don't believe what you hear about me because its not who I am today.
Lay with me and get to know me (trace the lines of my tattoo's)
You might as well, because the world has a piss poor view of me (and I don't care what they think) and there's nothing for you to lose by figuring out the truth.
My advice is that I don't want you to wait for me (don't hold your breath for me) but knowing that you are waiting for me will be comforting and make me feel special for the first time in my life. 
You need to know that my advice isn't the best because I'm bad at life and don't know how to express to you how special you really are to me and I'm going to f**k up a good thing again by constantly pushing away the people who are the best for me. (example: you)

Now lets get close again because it is so hard to stay away from you, we'll get in the car and leave all of this behind and chase a perfect life. Just you, me and love is all we need. 
Now I'm asking you to to take care of my damaged heart because everyone I've ever trusted with it has broken it even more. So I need you to understand it is not the fact that I don't trust you, but the fact that I can't trust that my feelings and emotions will ever be meaningful to anyone in life with how they have always been abused.

Now I'm going to push you away again because I have had terrible life experiences and don't know how to handle the good ones without fearing the bad experiences are immanent.

At the same time your friends will be hypocrites because they will tell you I'm not good for you but then live their lives ignoring their own advice. You can't trust anyone in life to make decisions about your life because they're not you. 

Now I'm going to push you away again because it puts me somewhere where I am most comfortable. No one can hurt me if I'm hurting myself. I
